layout.name: typo
layout.title: Detect
layout.tooltip: Which kind of object should be searched for?.

layout.name: layer
layout.title: Layer
layout.tooltip: The layer to detect for. Leave blank to detect for any layer.

layout.name: id
layout.title: Specific ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of the thing that should be checked. 0 means no checking (should be 1-1000 for BGOs and NPCs, 1-2000 for blocks, nothing for warps, and for fluids water with odd numbers, quicksand with even numbers.)

children.name: addme
children.title: Add my speed
children.tooltip: If enabled and the block is on a moving layer, the block will add it's own speed along with the changed speed.

children.name: correct
children.title: Correct position
children.tooltip: While this is true the block will attempt to align the position of the block to where it's supposed to be when colliding.

layout.name: destroy
layout.title: One use
layout.tooltip: If set to true, the moment the block detects a valid object, it destroys itself.

layout.name: event
layout.title: Event Trigger
layout.tooltip: An event to trigger if this block has been triggered
